leveling.assistedDesc: Guided leveling with automatic Z offset.
leveling.verifyDesc: Available after a successful leveling session.
leveling.verifyNoDataHint: Complete an assisted leveling session first.
leveling.verifyRecordMissingHint: The printer is still marked as leveled, but the corner measurements from that session are no longer on this printer. Run a re-check to measure the plate again.
leveling.verifyClearOffsetMsg:
Starting a re-check clears the current Z offset. It will only be set again after verification completes successfully.

Do you want to continue?
leveling.manualDesc: Manual Z adjustment for experienced users.
leveling.manualAdvancedWarning: Manual Leveling is intended for advanced users. We recommend using Assisted Leveling instead. Proceed only if you know what you're doing.
leveling.removeVat: Remove the resin vat and safely set it aside
leveling.checkLcdClean: Confirm the LCD and build plate are clean
leveling.checkInstallPlate: Install the build plate and ensure it is fully secured
leveling.downwardWarning: This printer homes downward toward the screen.
leveling.downwardStep1: Remove the resin vat so the build plate cannot collide with it.
leveling.downwardStep2: Take the build plate off the carriage to keep the screen safe.
leveling.downwardStep3: Make sure nothing is sitting on the LCD before homing starts.
leveling.introMessage: This wizard will guide you through automated force-sensor leveling.
leveling.introDetail: The printer will clear the current Z offset, move the Z axis, probe the screen and corner positions, then save the final Z offset. Keep the resin vat removed and the motion path clear.
leveling.screenTypeWaveReleaseFilmDesc: Textured release film over the screen.
leveling.settingsScreenTypeHint: Saved screen used to skip selection on next run.
leveling.settingsZOffsetHint: The offset applied during the last leveling session.
leveling.settingsZOffsetDialogDesc: Adjusts the offset from the LCD.
leveling.emergencyStopMsg:
The leveling process was interrupted before completion. No calibration offset was saved.

Please complete leveling again before starting a print.
leveling.wizardMovingToProbe: The build plate is moving into position. Please keep clear.
leveling.wizardPuckInstruction: Please place the Leveling Spacer in the {corner} corner{hint}.
leveling.wizardBelowResolutionBody:
The plate failed the check, but the remaining tilt is too small for a screw turn to fix reliably.

Tap Re-check to measure again. If this keeps coming back, make sure all screws are evenly snug, then re-check. If the result is only just over the limit, you can Skip and continue.
leveling.wizardCancelMsg:
Are you sure you want to cancel?

Progress will be lost and you will return to the leveling menu.
leveling.wizardIntroDetail: Your printer will use the force sensor for leveling.
leveling.wizardAlignInstr: Align the build plate to the screen, then tap Done.
leveling.loosenInstruction: Loosen all screws evenly and slightly — no more than 1/2 turn each.
leveling.tightenInstructionPro: Snug-tighten each screw with the long end of the hex key.
leveling.tightenInstructionStandard: Press down firmly on the build plate with one hand while tightening each screw with the long end of the hex key. Tighten in a cross pattern, no more than ¼ turn at a time.
leveling.hexLongEndInstruction: Please use the long end of the 3mm hex key.
leveling.hexShortEndInstruction: Please use the short end of the 3mm hex key.
leveling.tightenConfirmMsg:
Are all leveling screws evenly snug?

Loose screws can allow the build plate to shift during printing!
leveling.wizardRemovePuckInstr: Corner leveling complete. Please remove the Leveling Spacer from the LCD screen.
leveling.wizardDivergedWarning: Deviation increased — adjustment may have gone wrong. See log for details.
leveling.wizardDoNotTouch: Please do not touch the printer
leveling.wizardBackScrewAlt: If the back screw can't turn further, loosen both front screws slightly instead — this tilts the plate the same way.
leveling.wizardSkewBody:
The build arm is not levelable in its current state — the required screw adjustment exceeds what the leveling screws can apply. This can be fixed using the Concepts3D Pro Arm Leveling Guide.

Scan the QR code to open the guide.
leveling.adjustmentIntroBody:
A live force gauge shows pressure on the build plate.
Turn the indicated screw slowly with the short end of the hex key.
Center the dot — green means you've hit the target.
leveling.adjustmentIntroCaveat:
Important: After each turn, remove your hand and hex key from the arm.
Let the reading settle — even light pressure can throw off the force sensor.
leveling.wizardSkipMsg:
The deviation is above the 0.100 mm threshold. Skipping adjustment may result in an inadequately leveled plate.

Are you sure you want to proceed without adjusting?
leveling.settingsArmHint: Saved arm used to skip selection on next run.

levelingWorkflow.measurementsPending: Measurements will appear after this probe completes.

levelingWorkflow.offsetSuccess: The build arm offset has been applied and saved.
